root_cause.text: The `io_import_umem` function in the io_uring zero-copy receive (zcrx) subsystem fails to deallocate the dynamically allocated `pages` array when returning an error after a failure during scatter-gather table initialization.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that inside the error path of `io_import_umem` in `io_uring/zcrx.c`, `kvfree(pages)` was added immediately after `unpin_user_pages(pages, nr_pages)` to release the allocated page array memory.
